              TextTalk (TTS) Software Release Notes
                   Dialogic TTS for Windows NT
                        Version 1.00

Copyright © 1996 Dialogic Corporation
All Rights Reserved

TruVoice is a registered trademark of Centigram Communications.

Release documented: TextTalk Version 1.0.  TextTalk is a software only 
version of Centigram’s TruVoice Text-To-Speech converter that works with 
Dialogic boards. This document contains software installation information and 
product summary.

This TTS software release package contains the following components:

  a) A single installation routine that installs the TextTalk TTS software.

  b) These release notes that provide information about changes, bug fixes, 
  compatibility issues, and restrictions for each product’s software.


Change Summary
This is the first release


New Features
This is the first release


Product summary
Features of this release include 
a) Supports 4 channels of  English TTS.
b) Works with Dialogic System Release 96-11 and above.
c) Supports a user dictionary tool (UserDict.exe).

Product Features
1) Password Security
To enable TextTalk , you need to type in a password using the enablement 
diskette shipped separately by Dialogic. You can also run TextTalk for 30 days 
without purchasing a password from Dialogic. Please refer to the TextTalk 
Password Installation Notes for more details.

2)User Dictionary
Run the tool UserDict.exe by clicking on the User Dictionary icon. Choose the 
‘Dictionary’ button and it brings up the Pronunciation Manager window. The 
user dictionary can be generated on one machine and copied to other machines. 
The user dictionary is path name is stored in the registry entry key : 
HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Centigram\TextToSpeech\Dictionary.


Hardware Installation
Refer to the Voice Hardware Reference or the Quick Install Card for the board.


Software Installation
The TextTalk TTS Software should be installed after the  Dialogic Voice 
software is installed.
The installation package installs the `TextTalk TTS for Windows NT - Version 
1.00`.
To install the package follow the procedure below.
1. Run setup.exe and follow the instructions on the screen.
2. Install the enablement diskette that is shipped separately by Dialogic.
3. Run the program pwinstal.exe to enable TextTalk.

The Package installs the following directories :
 a) CLIB : contain the Borland compatibility files.
 a) INC : contains the include files
 b) LIB : contains the DLL and lib files.
 c) USERDICT : conatains the user dictionary tool.
 d) SAMPLES : conatains a GUI and console demo with source code.

NOTES:1. Dialogic System Release 96-11 for Windows NT must be installed 
first.


Demonstration Programs
  1) To run the demo with more than 1 channel, type ttsdemo -c<number of 
     channels> from the MS-DOS prompt.
     The demo text file state01.inp can be modified to include any text 
     that you want spoken.
     All demo source code is provided.
  2) A GUI demo and source code is also provided (SpeechApp.exe).


Compatibility Issues
This release is not compatible with any Dialogic System Release prior to 96-11.
Restrictions and Limitations
1. The maximum number of available concurrent channels is four (4).
2. The package will not work until the enablement diskette is installed and the 
program pwinstal.exe is run.
3. The user dictionary tool (UserDict.exe) can be used without a wave device on the 
machine, but no speech output will be played when the speaker button is clicked. To
listen to the modified pronuncaition without a wave device, play the text using the 
GUI demo (SpeechApp.exe).
